capabilities: Render fretboard diagrams from YAML in ```fretboard code blocks
Auto-generate chord and scale names, including slash chords, tensions, and passing notes
Highlight root notes and compute interval degree labels automatically
Lay out multiple diagrams side by side and chord progression sheets
Style diagrams with orientation, boxes, paths, barres, and per-note colors
extras: The chord progression sheet feature is explicitly marked experimental with syntax that may still change; the README includes documented limitations (interval ambiguity beyond one octave) and detailed error-handling behavior.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw guitar chord or scale fretboard diagrams inside notes, so guitarists must use images or external tools.

relations.evidence: This isn't staff notation (pair it with something like abcjs if you need that)

summary: Renders guitar fretboard diagrams as SVG from a lightweight YAML syntax inside fenced code blocks, with automatic chord/scale naming and root highlighting.
